title: PushUpgradeCustomization - Data API
description: Customized push upgrades allow a package subscriber to block push upgrades to their org. Package developers control which subscribers can opt into customized push upgrades. Each push upgrade customization maps to a specific package and to a specific subscriber org. This object is available in API version 60.0 and later.

CustomUpgradeType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CustomUpgradeType.description: The type of push upgrade customization. Possible values are: BlockedBySubscriber—Blocked By Subscriber None The default value is None.

ExpirationDays.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExpirationDays.description: The number of days that a subscriber is allowed to block push upgrades. Enter -1 to set customized push upgrades to never expire. The default value is null.

HasRestrictionEnabled.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
HasRestrictionEnabled.description: Indicates whether the subscriber org has blocked push upgrades. The default value is false.

IsCustomUpgradeAllowed.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsCustomUpgradeAllowed.description: Indicates whether the package developer has allowed a subscriber to opt into customized push upgrades. The default value is false.

IsRestrictionOverridden.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsRestrictionOverridden.description: Indicates whether customized push upgrades have been overridden by Salesforce Customer Support for the subscriber org. The default value is false.

PushUpgradeBlockInitiatedDate.description: The date that IsCustomUpgradeAllowed was set to true.
